name: South Gate Outpost
summary: At South Gate Outpost, mountaineers guard the pass between Dun Morogh and Loch Modan. Their fortified post watches the southern road from Ironforge's frigid heights to the Loch's temperate valley.

sections.title: Watchers of the Southern Road
sections.body: At South Gate Outpost, snowy slopes give way to Loch Modan's basin. Ironforge mountaineers patrol the rocky switchbacks and keep dangerous wildlife off the main highway. Their kin at North Gate Outpost face a harder fight, but the southern road is largely secure. Travelers, pilgrims, and trade wagons can reach Thelsamar in relative safety.

faq.q: What is the purpose of South Gate Outpost?
aliases: why is south gate outpost here
faq.answer: Mountaineers hold South Gate Outpost as a fortified border checkpoint and garrison along South Gate Pass. They keep the snowy road clear of mountain beasts and hostile interlopers traveling between Dun Morogh and Loch Modan.

faq.q: Why is it so much calmer here than at North Gate Outpost?
aliases: difference between north gate and south gate
faq.answer: South Gate's garrison has culled aggressive wildlife beside the road. North Gate Outpost faces heavier incursions and wilder mountain terrain, leaving the southern pass comparatively calm.

faq.q: Where does the road through South Gate Outpost lead?
faq.answer: Westward, the road climbs through the pass into Dun Morogh's snowy highlands toward Ironforge. Eastward, it descends into Loch Modan's temperate valley, then winds toward Thelsamar.

angles.text: For dwarves leaving Coldridge Valley and Dun Morogh for the first time, South Gate Outpost is the last chilly landmark before the descent into Loch Modan's vibrant, sunlit lands.
For the Alliance, South Gate Outpost offers dependable military shelter along one of Khaz Modan's primary domestic supply lines. It keeps the passage between the capital and eastern settlements open.
